containment_probe_note: compute_occupancy is a ray-parity test: a point inside a CLOSED furniture volume crosses an even number of surfaces on the way out (cabinet wall + room wall), so the room reads as 'outside'. Crossing counts per axis are recorded here beside passing peers from the same placement.

A_miss_cap_audit_clamp.mechanism: audit_miss_report clamps the audit cap to min(declared, DEFAULT_MAX_MISS_RATE) in canonical mode (render_depth.py:524) -- an r5 anti-forgery clamp written when 0.0025 was the ONLY registered cap. Amendment 4.3 registered a second, MODE-SPECIFIC cap (listener 0.007) and this line was not updated, so a canonical listener render RENDERS under 0.7% and AUDITS under 0.25%. Every map between the two caps fails with the pair of warnings 'claims within_cap=True, recomputed False' + 'above the 0.250% cap applied here'.
A_miss_cap_audit_clamp.evidence: all 17 miss rates fall strictly between 0.25% and 0.7% (0.251%-0.656%); every passing slot in these placements is <= 0.243%; the count and the room match Amendment 4.3's own basis exactly -- 17 positions over the source cap, all FurnishedRoom, worst 0.656%.
A_miss_cap_audit_clamp.class: implementation defect in the Amendment 4.3 wiring, not a policy question
A_miss_cap_audit_clamp.recommended: fix, do not register: audit_miss_report must clamp to the cap registered for the MODE being rendered (registered_miss_cap(listener_mode)), not to DEFAULT_MAX_MISS_RATE. The anti-forgery property is preserved -- a run still cannot audit itself against a looser cap than its own registered one.

B_camera_containment.mechanism: open3d compute_occupancy/compute_signed_distance take their SIGN from the closest triangle's NORMAL, not from ray parity. The RAF gauge has determinant -1, so load_mesh_pipeline inverts triangle winding, and a scanned room has locally ambiguous orientation (double-sided furniture panels). A mic whose nearest triangle happens to face away reads 'outside the room' while sitting inside it.
B_camera_containment.evidence: six-axis crossing counts are 1 in every direction -- identical to passing peers in the same placements, i.e. in-and-out through a single wall; all three are inside the mesh AABB; bounds_ok is True (the whole reconstructed cloud stays inside the mesh box); depth max 5.8-6.7 m is room-scale; miss rates are 0.002%-0.081%, i.e. essentially every ray measured -- a camera genuinely outside a room misses hugely; and the vertical/nadir gate passes on all three.
B_camera_containment.class: measurement artifact of a normal-orientation test on a non-watertight, det(-1)-transformed scan mesh
B_camera_containment.recommended: register as a RECORDED diagnostic for LISTENER maps, per the Amendment 4.1/4.2 precedent: the gate that decides the gauge is the vertical/nadir check (mesh-independent, passes here), plus bounds_ok and the AABB sightline bound, all of which pass. camera_inside stays FATAL for SOURCE maps, where a source stands in open space and 'outside' means outside. Disclose the 3 items alongside the p008/p052 flags and add them to the minus-flagged sensitivity row.

vertical_gate_summary.reading: the gauge is fine: every one of the 20 failing maps passes the mesh-INDEPENDENT vertical check, and its delta distribution is indistinguishable from the 124 passing slots'.
